_comment: Template for ~/.graphify/providers.json. Copy this to ~/.graphify/providers.json and edit API keys/base_url as needed. This file is per-user (lives in HOME), not per-project — do NOT commit the real ~/.graphify/providers.json.
_comment_2: The 'minimax' provider defines MiniMax as a custom provider for graphify. The extra_body field disables reasoning tokens (saves ~20-30% per call). Only MiniMax-M3 supports this flag; the M2.x family ignores it.
